ohtani.title: Manny Machado drives in three runs in Padres' 4-1 win
ohtani.blurb: Manny Machado collects three RBIs, including a two-run home run, propelling the Padres to 4-1 win over the Dodgers

imanaga.title: Griffin Conine hits go-ahead single in Marlins' win
imanaga.blurb: Griffin Conine hits a go-ahead single in the 12th inning and Kyle Stowers homers in the Marlins' 8-2 win over the Cubs

suzuki.title: Kyle Stowers, Joe Mack fuel Marlins in 3-2 win
suzuki.blurb: Kyle Stowers hits a home run and Joe Mack drives in the go-ahead run to lift the Marlins to a 3-2 win over the Cubs\n

yoshida.title: Sonny Gray, Wilyer Abreu shine in 4-0 shutout win
yoshida.blurb: Seven innings of shutout ball from Sonny Gray and Wilyer Abreu's 22nd homer of the year lead the Red Sox to a 4-0 win over the Pirates

okamoto.title: Encarnacion-Strand lifts Orioles to a 4-2 victory
okamoto.blurb: Christian Encarnacion-Strand slugs a home run and three RBIs plus Trey Gibson fans seven to lead the Orioles to a 4-2 win over the Blue Jays

murakami.title: Maikel Garcia collects three RBIs in the Royals' win
murakami.blurb: Maikel Garcia collects three RBIs and Vinnie Pasquantino hits an RBI double in the Royals' 5-4 win over the White Sox

matsui.title: Manny Machado drives in three runs in Padres' 4-1 win
matsui.blurb: Manny Machado collects three RBIs, including a two-run home run, propelling the Padres to 4-1 win over the Dodgers
